mech_chassis.note: Variant rule (EXE ids 700-771, 'Atlas A'): Korean chassis name + one space + the Latin capital letter, unchanged. A = Armor variant (장갑 강화형), W = Weapon load variant (화력 강화형), J = Jump-capable variant (점프형). The letters are tied to the A/W/J buttons of the purchase screen (art LSPBIM01-09) - never translate or lower-case them. Example: 'Mad Cat A' -> '매드캣 A', 'Hunchback IIc J' -> '헌치백 IIC J'.
